evals.description: Happy path: inbox/ contains a .feedback file with valid FeedScript ops. Verifies CLI is invoked, ops are applied, and file is deleted.
evals.expected_output: CLI processes human.feedback. Skill reports 1 ops applied. .feedback file is deleted. decisions/log.mem gets a +inbox: entry.

assertions.text: .memplan/inbox/human.feedback no longer exists after the skill runs
Output reports the number of ops applied (e.g. 1 ops applied)

evals.description: Empty inbox: no .feedback files present. Verifies skill reports empty and does not error.
evals.expected_output: Skill reports Inbox: empty -- no pending feedback. No errors raised.

assertions.text: Output contains a message indicating inbox was empty
Skill completes without halting or raising an error

evals.description: Malformed feedback file: .feedback contains an unknown verb. Verifies errors are reported and processing continues (not aborted).
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/inbox /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/decisions && printf "APPROVE step=1
UNKNOWN_VERB foo=bar
APPROVE step=2
" > /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/inbox/bad.feedback && touch /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/decisions/log.mem /tmp/eval-inbox-2/.memplan/memory/questions.mem
evals.expected_output: Skill reports 2 ops applied and 1 error. bad.feedback is deleted. questions.mem contains a +unknown-op: entry for the bad line.

assertions.text: 2 valid ops were applied despite the error (APPROVE step=1 and APPROVE step=2)

evals.description: ANSWER op round-trip: a .feedback file contains an ANSWER FeedScript op targeting an open question in questions.mem. Verifies the CLI applies the ANSWER op so the question entry in questions.mem gains the supplied answer text, and the decision log records the event.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/inbox && printf "+question:qid=q1,text=Should we use real-db or mocks?,status=open
" > /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/memory/questions.mem && printf "ANSWER qid=q1 text="Use real-db; mocks are banned by persona"
" > /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/inbox/answer.feedback && touch /tmp/eval-inbox-3/.memplan/decisions/log.mem
evals.expected_output: The ANSWER op is applied: questions.mem is updated so that question q1 is marked as answered and the supplied text (Use real-db; mocks are banned by persona) is recorded. answer.feedback is deleted. decisions/log.mem contains a +inbox: entry. The skill reports at least 1 op applied.

assertions.text: questions.mem contains the answer text Use real-db; mocks are banned by persona associated with qid=q1
The q1 entry in questions.mem no longer has status=open (it is marked as answered)
.memplan/inbox/answer.feedback no longer exists after the skill runs
.memplan/decisions/log.mem contains a +inbox: entry recording the processed op
Output reports at least 1 op applied
